risks.title: Economic and Consumer Spending Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K explicitly identifies overall economic conditions, inflation levels, consumer spending patterns and pricing power as core factors affecting financial results, with specific reference to tariff-driven macroeconomic volatility and recessionary concerns.

risks.title: Competitive Pricing and Fashion Trends
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K explicitly mentions changes in competitive pricing, promotional activity and difficulty predicting fashion trend shifts as factors that could materially affect financial results.

risks.title: Geopolitical Instability and International Conflicts
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K specifically references war, geopolitical instability, impacts of Middle East conflicts and Ukraine war, plus related sanctions as factors with potential material impact on financial results.

risks.title: Trade Policy and Tariff Risk
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K provides extensive discussion of U.S. tariff increases enacted in 2025, IEEPA tariffs invalidated in 2026, reciprocal tariffs from foreign jurisdictions and ongoing policy uncertainty, with explicit statement that tariffs could negatively impact financial results.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruption and Labor Costs
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K explicitly mentions labor shortages, labor cost increases, raw material cost inflation, transportation cost increases and import delays as material risk factors affecting operations and profitability.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Technology System Breaches
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K references material disruptions and security breaches affecting technology systems as potential risks, with dedicated Item 1C on Cybersecurity governance.

risks.title: Regulatory and Tax Changes
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K references changes in effective tax rates, accounting standards, regulatory changes and legal matters as risk factors, though less emphasized than operational risks.

risks.title: Intellectual Property Protection
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K mentions inability to protect intellectual property rights as a potential risk factor affecting brand differentiation and competitive position.

risks.title: Seasonal Fluctuations and Inventory Management
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K references seasonal fluctuations in gross sales as a specific risk factor, common in retail but requiring careful inventory and working capital management.

ai_positioning.summary: Urban Outfitters mentions artificial intelligence in the context of technology advancements and effective utilization.
